meta.title: Legal framework | Patent Insurance Strategy
meta.description: Vietnamese law on patent insurance today, the barriers, and proposed reforms across five areas of law.

header.title:
A gap
waiting to be filled
header.lead:
Vietnam has no dedicated patent insurance
product on the market yet.

items.note: An early draft mentioned “insurance products” but it was not adopted.
Allows new non-life products to be designed.
Property rights can be pledged as security.
No specific guidance on patent valuation.
Rights to data are property rights.

items.law: Law on S&T and Innovation 2025 · High Technology Law 2025

items.title: Law
items.body: No financing or risk-sharing mechanism for patents; the draft on insurance products was not adopted.

items.title: Market
items.body: Weak patent commercialisation and intermediaries such as valuers and brokers.

items.title: Data
items.body: Patent risk data is fragmented and unconnected.

items.title: Capacity
items.body: Insurers lack experience; businesses lack awareness.

items.title: Nature of patents
items.body: Patent value is hard to predict and quantify.

points: Amend Art. 115 to clarify the nature of property rights
Add judicial oversight to Art. 303 for high-value collateral
Amend Art. 306: independent valuation at enforcement
Recognise support and loan guarantees backed by IP rights
Define core products: infringement liability, application, litigation costs
Encourage uptake; consider mandatory cover for high-value exploitation
Patent valuation guidance based on IVS 210
Assess scope, term, useful life and legal risk
Define what is traded on data markets
Tiered property rights along the data lifecycle
A registry for data property rights
